entities.name: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       d.nationality,
       r.name AS first_race_name
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId

entities.name: What is the lap record for the Austrian Grand Prix Circuit?

entities.name: Please list the lap records for the circuits in Italy.

properties.sql: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) as time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL ) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime as lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) as min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 on fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 on T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy' ) AS T4 ON (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') + 1, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') - INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, INSTR(T1.FastestLapTime, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1

entities.name: What is the average fastest lap time in seconds for Lewis Hamilton in all the Formula_1 races?

         (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(T1.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)

properties.sql: WITH time_in_seconds AS ( SELECT T2.year, T2.raceId, T1.positionOrder, CASE WHEN T1.positionOrder = 1 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 1, 1) AS REAL) * 3600) + (CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 3, 2) AS REAL) * 60) + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 6,2) AS REAL )   + CAST(SUBSTR(T1.time, 9) AS REAL)/1000 ELSE 0 END AS time_seconds FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.time IS NOT NULL ), champion_time AS ( SELECT year, raceId, time_seconds FROM time_in_seconds WHERE positionOrder = 1 ) SELECT year, AVG(time_seconds) FROM champion_time WHERE year < 1975 GROUP BY year HAVING AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL

entities.name: Which drivers born after 1975 have been ranked 2? Please give their forenames and surnames.

FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob > '1975-12-31'

entities.name: On what year did the youngest driver had his first qualifying race? Also state the name, date and time of the race.

properties.sql:
-- Your SQL query
SELECT r.year AS race_year,
       r.name AS race_name,
       r.date AS race_date,
       r.time AS race_time
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId

ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC

entities.name: In which race did the fastest 1st lap time was recorded? Please indicate the time in milliseconds.

entities.name: List down top 3 German drivers who has the shortest average pit stop duration and were born between 1980-1985.

properties.sql: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T2.nationality = 'German' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985' GROUP BY T2.forename, T2.surname ORDER BY AVG(T1.duration) LIMIT 3
